$comment: Every installed pre-release dependency, with the three things a release candidate needs: who owns it, why it is acceptable, and what would make us leave. scripts/prerelease-audit.mjs fails on a pre-release that is not here, an entry whose version no longer matches the tree, and an entry without an ADR that exists.

drizzle-orm.why: The only release line that ships the typed relational queries and migration splitter this repository is written against; 0.44 is a different API, not a smaller version of this one.
drizzle-orm.exit: Migrate when 1.0.0 is GA: bump the catalog, hand-run `migrate-forward-only.test.ts` and `migrations-forward-only.mjs`, and delete this entry.

drizzle-kit.why: Must match drizzle-orm exactly; a generator from a different line emits migrations the runtime cannot read.
drizzle-kit.exit: Same commit as drizzle-orm: GA, then regenerate every migration once and confirm `migrations-forward-only.mjs` still passes.

@monaco-editor/react.why: 4.7 does not lift Monaco out of the server-rendered bundle; the RC is the release that made the editor import-safe, and the code editor is unusable without it.
@monaco-editor/react.exit: Move to 4.8.x stable when published; the only API used is `<Editor>` with `onMount`, so the swap is a version bump plus one screenshot.

node-pty.why: 1.1 has no Node 26 prebuild, so it compiles native code on every install; the beta ships the prebuilt binary the terminal needs.
node-pty.exit: 1.2.0 stable, or 1.1 gaining a Node 26 prebuild — either removes the beta and the build step.
